hint: stat-chart-figure-v1: a title longer than about 6 Korean characters, more than about 10 classes or ticks, showValues on a dense chart, or a value label that would touch a polygon line cannot be placed legibly: shorten the title (at most 14 characters), use fewer classes, switch showValues off, or draw one chart per figure. Only the documented keys are allowed in the plan, and kind is one of HISTOGRAM, FREQUENCY_POLYGON, STEM_LEAF, BOX_PLOT, SCATTER, DICE_TABLE, TREE. A pie chart, a bar chart of categories or a cumulative frequency graph is not supported: answer UNSUPPORTED.
